Mega Evolution series · 30C

30th Celebration

Released September 16, 2026 · 161 cards

StandardExpanded

30th Celebration is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Mega Evolution series, released in English on September 16, 2026. Its main set has 128 cards, plus 33 secret rares numbered beyond the set (161 in total). It includes 158 Pokémon, 3 Trainer and 0 Energy cards, and is legal in the Standard and Expanded formats.

Illustrators

125 illustrators worked on 30th Celebration. Most cards: 5ban Graphics (9), YOSHIROTTEN (5), HYOGONOSUKE (3), mashu (3), OKUBO (3), Yuka Morii (3), akagi (2), AKIRA EGAWA (2).
